fit.objective: sum_n time_weight[n] ||J alpha + omega cross(J omega) - actuator_torque||^2
fit.inertia_scale_gauge: trace(J) fixed at nominal; rotational equation alone cannot identify common J/torque scale
fit.inertia_chart: C=s*C0^(1/2) exp(sum_5 z_i B_i) C0^(1/2), tr(C)=tr(J_nom)/2; J=tr(C)I-C; tracefree symmetric B_i
fit.mass: nominal, irrelevant to rotational-only equation; not identified
fit.fixed_geometry: nominal rotor locations, arm yaws, gimbal thrust-origin offset and reaction moment/force ratio
fit.initial_tau_source: median retained command period; numerical seed, not a physical nominal value
fit.residual_mean: computed only after physical LS from completed training prefix; frozen additive torque in subsequent prediction; not a free fit nuisance
fit.covariance_role: Gauss-Newton chart-support curvature diagnostic conditional on SG and fixed controls; overlapping SG errors are correlated and a near-boundary inertia chart can collapse, so not a calibrated physical posterior; discarded numerical chart directions do not mean physical certainty; see separate identifiability audit
fit.finite_nonconvergence_policy: save optimizer residuals and continue prediction; no quality rejection

identifiability.role: read-only training diagnostics; no fit or prediction acceptance gate
identifiability.boundary_interpretation: C=tr(J)/2 I-J is the physical second moment. A small positive C eigenvalue means the unconstrained log chart approaches the planar-body boundary; it is not set to zero. Vanishing sensitivity of that chart is distinct from an additional structurally unobservable physical parameter.
identifiability.direct_physical_coordinates: five Frobenius-orthonormal trace-free symmetric inertia perturbations in kg m^2; CoG xyz in m; four log force effectiveness coordinates; log thrust tau
identifiability.direct_physical_spectrum_caution: Mixed coordinate units; not a unit-independent condition-number. Full local rank does not establish global identifiability or calibrated uncertainty.
identifiability.covariance_caution: Log-chart Gauss-Newton support covariance is only local curvature. Near a physical inertia boundary it is not a reliable Gaussian physical posterior; a discarded numerical chart direction must not be interpreted as certain. No parameter covariance is used for the angular-rate comparison bands.
identifiability.force_scope: Rotational equation only: translational force balance and mass are not fitted. Effectiveness is an effective rotational calibration in the fixed nominal trace(J) scale gauge, not independently recovered thrust calibration.

data_flow_verification.method: replace unused reference/dense/past-sensor arrays with NaN; rerun predictor with unchanged sparse rows, q0, frozen model and torque
data_flow_verification.failure_policy: record result; not a scientific state-acceptance or covariance gate

numerical_sensitivity.role: numerical sensitivity diagnostic only; does not change model, law, or accepted observations
numerical_sensitivity.direct_actuator: same exact existing ZOH first-order response, same point and measured-gimbal interpolation at profile-cell midpoints

baseline: same nominal-start parameters and initial tau, with its own strictly past mocap residual mean; previous other-bag tau not reused
torque: recorded issued rotor thrust, measured gimbal, refined first-order actuator response and frozen training residual mean
candidate_law: independent six-point gyro increment factors, exact quaternion second and rotation first/full covariance moments
displayed_rpy: f(E[R]) and local delta-method covariance; not exact Euler moments or guaranteed coverage
bands: conditional on point physical parameters and frozen past torque mean; no parameter covariance or unknown future torque uncertainty included
